diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies unconditional Switch.Off after the 15-minute delay, but the JoI uses an if-gate that requires temperature > 28. At 900000ms the temperature is null, so the guard fails and switch_off() never executes (F2 shows IR emits switch.off but JoI emits nothing).
diagnosis.change_summary: Replace conditional if with unconditional call to match IR's sequential wait-on-delay-off pattern. Preserves timing and binding; the IR does not condition the off action on temperature.
